changelog:
v1.34.0 - **Combat depth pass + menu/UI polish (v1.34.0).** A broad gameplay + UX release. **Power level-ups fixed:** active powers showed "Lv.0 → Lv.1" forever and silently reset to level 1 whenever a new power was found or re-slotted — the fork card never carried its tier (display bug) and `_rebuild_power_states()` wiped every power's level on each unlock/HUD-slot swap (state-loss bug); fork cards now carry the real tier and the rebuild preserves still-equipped powers (+ a `test_powers` regression). **Weapons now level 1→10** (was 5) with creative per-weapon "Mastery" trees (L6-10) — escalating damage/reach/rate plus a signature mechanic and an L10 capstone that foreshadows each evolution (bleed-stacking Coltello, stun-locking Manganello, 360° Catena, launching Mazza, and so on); **evolutions now trigger after L10** instead of L5. **Melee secondaries reworked for area control:** Manganellata → 360° stun ring + lingering stun field; Mulinello → a Vortex that pulls enemies inward (new PhysicalMelee `pull` flag) + bleeds; Schianto al Suolo → bigger blast + a slow crater; Spazzata → wide knockdown that displaces the lane; Iaido → a long dash-slash with a bleeding wake. **New "Latte" power:** a thrown squirt of thick white liquid (30° arc, 6 m, launched from ~1 m) that lands as a 1 m reflective pool (5 s) which repels male enemies (flee to ≥6 m, then keep distance) and attracts female enemies (walk in, then stand) — driven by a new `genre: male|female|other` field on every enemy; includes a small skill tree. **Main-menu music:** a random track among all the game's music now plays in the menu and shop overlay and stops when a run starts. **Level-up + "reveal all" popups** restyled to the same Neon Manga look as the ESC menu (choice cards glow by rarity within that style); the reveal-all view is now organized into **category tabs** — Weapons / Powers / Borsello / Drugs / Music (powers were previously absent from that pool and are now included). **Melee swoosh VFX fixed** to cover 100% of the real attack arc + range: the swing trail now reads the leveled `range_m` (it had used the weapon model's fixed length) and aims along the clean handle direction (the Catena's flexible-chain physics tip was flinging the swoosh off-cursor; the rigid Katana was already correct). **Brawler's Resolve** — the on-melee-hit damage-reduction buff — now shows as a 💪 status badge with a countdown ring; it was applying correctly the whole time but was invisible. Verified: every change is headless `--import`-clean and was validated against the relevant `tools/test_*.tscn` suites as it landed (a final consolidated local run was blocked by an open editor — the push-triggered CI runs all 10 suites); the UI/visual deltas (manga styling, tabs, Latte pool, swoosh coverage) still want an in-editor eyeball.
v1.33.0 - Fix PlayScene loading freeze and main menu styling: restore the accidentally deleted `create_hud_slot` function in `UIStyles.gd`, fix invalid `get_theme_color_override` calls in Godot 4, wrap Main Menu layout in a `PanelContainer` card, and dynamically theme full-screen `ColorRect` background overlays.
v1.32.0 - Fix GDScript compile errors in PauseMenu.gd and MenuScene.gd by preloading UIStyles as a script-level constant, resolving lambda closure capture limitations.
